title.narrative: Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) addressed public health emergencies and famine prevention, strengthened community systems, and boosted service demand through awareness, engagement, and feedback. It reached over 10 million people, engaging 4.6 million directly, to enhance resilience, knowledge, and socio-behavioural data use for effective community participation.
